resolutionPath.approach: Source-backed deterministic re-author, not a decoding repair. The document is style-conformant: seven paragraphs carry a built-in heading style with an explicit w:outlineLvl and the other seven are body prose, so the heading set is closed by construction.
resolutionPath.corroboration: All seven superseded gold rows land on one of those seven paragraphs, and every stored level agrees with w:outlineLvl + 1.
resolutionPath.strongerProvenanceFound: bench/01-style-chuan.key is generated with the document and carries ordinal, level and text for all seven headings. The previous gold already cited it, with a matching sha. So the reference was never damaged - only the reading of it was, and the re-author is a re-read rather than an inference from style. This also avoids leaning on 'Heading1/2/3 implies semantic heading', which would contradict the standing invariant that a heading style is not semantic truth.
